content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the handling of the "cred" tag in the workflow actions. Initially, the "cred" field was set to the string "null" by default, which led to incorrect behavior when checking for credentials. The patch corrected this by changing the default value of the "cred" field to null (instead of the string "null") and added checks to ensure that the credential properties are only retrieved if the "cred" field is not null. This ensures that all actions in the workflow correctly handle the absence of a "cred" tag, preventing potential exceptions and ensuring proper credential management.
